title: Quietly Crunchy Turkish Vialone Nano Rice Dolma
description: A salty and crunchy Turkish dish featuring Vialone Nano rice, perfect for a sick day, made with sous-vide and Ayurvedic Tamasic-friendly ingredients, served in a dolma form.
instructions: Cook the Vialone Nano rice according to package instructions using a sous-vide machine at 180 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Mix the cooked rice with the sauteed onion and garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Prepare the grape leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
Fill each grape leaf with the rice mixture and roll into a dolma shape.
Serve the dolma warm or at room temperature.
Refrigerate or freeze the dolma for later use.
